set: A: the page at rest and the three keys, whole, and the smallest type at native size

issues.where: the whole form, between the label column and the field column
issues.what: roughly 330px of dead paper separates each label/helper from its field; rows are held together only by whitespace, so the label-to-field association is weak and the page reads wider than it needs to
issues.fix: narrow the label-column gap (pull fields left or cap the form width), or move labels above their fields so each row reads as one unit

issues.what: every field is an identical empty trough with only a chevron: no placeholder, example value, or format hint, so what to do first rests entirely on the helper text and the chevrons make 'Contact number' and 'Date of birth' read as dropdowns
issues.fix: give each field a faint placeholder or example (e.g. '(555) 555-5555', 'DD / MM / YYYY') so the expected input is legible at a glance

issues.where: over the Date of birth field, right of center
issues.what: the 'page at rest' shot contains a floating mouse cursor, so it is not actually at rest and the pointer draws the eye away from the intended first read
issues.fix: remove the cursor from the at-rest still; keep it only in the moment shots where it marks the mechanism being operated

issues.what: the instruction line hugs the top-left while the crank sits bottom-left and the meter bottom-right, leaving a large hollow middle; the panel interior reads sparse compared with the dial panel's tighter composition
issues.fix: vertically center the crank and meter against the instruction block, or reduce the panel height so the mechanism fills its container like the dial does

issues.where: bottom-right crop, captioned 'the text with the least contrast'
issues.what: the crop shows the step-indicator knobs and the header rule again, not any text, so the lowest-contrast text on the page is never shown at native size and cannot be verified
issues.fix: recrop the lowest-contrast text (the gray helper lines or footer note) at native size to match the caption
